name: granola
description: Your meetings in your workflow. Granola gives Cursor access to what your team discussed, decided, and committed to.

skills.name: granola-context
skills.description: Look up what was discussed or decided in meetings. Use when someone asks about a past discussion, needs to recall a decision, or references something that was talked about in a meeting.

skills.name: granola-prep
skills.description: Prepare for an upcoming meeting by pulling context from previous ones. Use when someone mentions they have a meeting coming up, or asks to be prepped for a conversation.

skills.name: granola-review
skills.description: Check current work against meeting decisions before submitting. Use when someone wants to verify their implementation, draft, or plan matches what was agreed.

subagents.name: granola-engineer
subagents.description: A decisions-aware assistant that anchors work to meeting context. Use proactively when implementing features that were discussed in meetings, or when the user needs their work grounded in team decisions.

rules.name: check-meeting-context
rules.description: Check Granola for relevant meeting context when working on features or making decisions

commands.name: granola-brief
commands.description: Synthesize everything discussed about a topic across meetings into a briefing document.

commands.name: granola-bug-report
commands.description: Turn a bug walkthrough call into a structured bug report.

commands.name: granola-gaps
commands.description: Find what was discussed in meetings but hasn't shown up in code yet.

commands.name: granola-plan
commands.description: Generate a prioritized build plan from recent meeting decisions and action items.

commands.name: granola-pr
commands.description: Write a PR description grounded in meeting decisions and discussions.

commands.name: granola-spec
commands.description: Build a structured spec from meeting discussions about a feature or project.
